faq: Will you change my live site straight away?
No. We duplicate the project or use a staging branch, make the changes there and send you a preview link. Only after you approve do we publish, so visitors never see half-finished work.
Can you edit a template I bought?
Yes, as long as the template license allows changes, which standard Webflow templates do. We keep the original structure where possible and tell you if a request would fight the template's design.
What if my request is bigger than the package?
We tell you before starting. You can pick the next package, trim the list or keep the extras for a later order. Nothing is added to your price without your written yes.
Do I need to give you my login?
No. Add us as a collaborator or workspace member from your Webflow settings. We never ask for your password and you can remove our access whenever the work is done.
desc:
Webflow design edits fix and extend your existing site: spacing, new sections, navigation, landing pages and mobile problems. Ecom Swift LLC makes each change on a backup copy first, checks every screen size, then publishes once you approve.

## What are Webflow design edits?

Webflow design edits are targeted changes to a site that already exists. They cover layout fixes, new sections, restyled components, rebuilt menus and extra pages that match your current look. They are smaller than a redesign and faster than a rebuild.

Most sites need this kind of help regularly. A section that looked fine on a laptop wraps badly on a phone, a new campaign needs a landing page, or a footer still lists an old address. Waiting for a full project to fix these things costs more than the fixes themselves.

## Why small design problems cost more than they look

Visitors rarely report a broken layout. They simply leave. A button that overlaps text on a tablet, a menu that will not open on a phone or an image that stretches out of proportion makes a business look careless. Those first impressions are hard to recover.

Edits made in a hurry can cause bigger trouble. Changing a shared class in Webflow can alter every page that uses it, and a quick fix on the live site can break a section nobody was looking at. Careful editing means understanding what a change touches before making it.

## How careful edits keep your site working

A good edit respects the structure already in the project. Reusing existing classes keeps the design consistent, while new styles are named clearly so later changes stay easy. Working on a duplicate means you see the result before visitors do, and the live site is never at risk.

Consistency also supports results. When buttons, headings and spacing follow one pattern, visitors learn how the site works quickly. Fixing mobile layout problems matters most, since many people first meet your site on a phone.

## What a good round of edits includes

- Spacing, alignment, color and typography fixes applied consistently.
- New sections or page templates built from your existing style.
- Navigation and footer updates, including dropdowns and mobile menus.
- Mobile and tablet breakpoints checked on real screen sizes.
- Reusable components and classes tidied so future edits stay simple.
- Image swaps with correct sizing and alt text.
- Landing pages that match the rest of the site.
- Form styling and a matching thank-you page.
- Before and after screenshots, so you can see exactly what changed.
- A written change log for larger rounds.

## How we handle your requests

You send a list of what looks wrong or what you want added, with screenshots if you have them. We confirm the scope and then duplicate the project so all work happens on a copy. After each batch of edits, we check desktop, tablet and phone widths, and cross-browser behavior on larger packages.

The Basic package covers a few small edits such as spacing, text, color or image changes. The Standard package adds layout work, one new section or template, navigation or footer changes and mobile fixes, with before and after screenshots. The Premium package covers a larger round with new pages in your style, tidied reusable components and a short change log. An extra page, an accessibility fixes pass and form styling are available as add-ons. If your request is bigger than the package, we tell you before we start.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send screenshots with arrows or short notes.
- Group related changes into one list.
- Tell us which device or browser shows the problem.
- Approve the preview before anything goes live.
- Keep a record of the final change log.

**Avoid:**
- Editing the live site while we work on the copy.
- Sending requests one at a time over several days.
- Asking for a full redesign inside a small package.
- Changing global styles without knowing what depends on them.
- Skipping a phone check after a desktop fix.

## Who this service is for

This service suits business owners whose site has drifted out of shape, marketers who need a new landing page quickly and teams who bought a template and want a few sections adjusted. It also suits anyone whose site breaks on phones and does not know where to start.

## What we need from you

Send the site address, your list of edits and any brand files or images to use. We never need your password. We work as a collaborator in your project, and you decide when the approved changes are published.
